subject: Your Codex plugins page
text:
Hi,

Came across your Codex plugins page on the Agent Skills Index. Having the install commands and the sync commit right there is really handy, and I like that you show when each one was added.

I run PickAPlugin, a hand-sorted directory of 350+ ChatGPT and Codex plugins. We put together a report on the Codex plugin scene that might be a useful extra source for that page: https://pickaplugin.com/research/state-of-codex-plugins-2026

Free to cite with a link back. Happy to link to your index from our guides too if a swap works for you.

Aaron, PickAPlugin

subject: Your Codex CLI plugins reference
text:
Hi Alex,

Your Codex CLI plugins reference is the clearest write-up of the manifest lookup order I've seen. Pulling the tables straight from the source is a smart way to keep it honest.

I run PickAPlugin, a hand-sorted directory of 350+ ChatGPT and Codex plugins. We have a short guide on validating plugin.json that could fit next to your manifest section: https://pickaplugin.com/guides/validate-plugin-json

We also did a report on Codex plugins that's free to cite: https://pickaplugin.com/research/state-of-codex-plugins-2026

If either is useful as a link, great. I'd happily point our readers to your reference too.

Aaron, PickAPlugin

subject: Link swap idea: MCP.Directory + PickAPlugin
text:
Hi,

I've been using MCP.Directory to look things up and the one-click install per client is a nice touch.

I run PickAPlugin, a hand-sorted directory of 350+ ChatGPT and Codex plugins. We have a guide on where to submit an MCP server (https://pickaplugin.com/guides/where-to-submit-mcp-server) and you're not on it yet, which I'd like to fix.

If you're open to it, a link back from one of your blog posts or resource pages would be great. Our Codex plugin report is also free to cite if it ever fits a post: https://pickaplugin.com/research/state-of-codex-plugins-2026

Aaron, PickAPlugin

subject: Swarmnest + PickAPlugin
text:
